bible_text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
quote_text: If He was the same yesterday, He has got to be the same today, in power, in principle, in every way. He has got to be the same Jesus, or He wasn't Jesus yesterday.
sermon_title: Jesus Christ The Same Yesterday, Today, And Forever

bible_text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
quote_text: Faith is not what you feel; faith is what you believe. Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

bible_text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
quote_text: Divine healing is already purchased. It's a finished work. Every redemptive blessing was settled at Calvary when Jesus died.
sermon_title: By His Stripes We Are Healed

bible_text: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers.
quote_text: The Message of the hour is to bring the people back to the original Word, back to the faith of the apostolic fathers.
sermon_title: The Restoration Of The Bride Tree

bible_text: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
quote_text: Don't look at what you are; look at what He is. Greater is He that is in you than he that is in the world. It's not your strength; it's His presence.
sermon_title: Greater Is He That Is In You
